note: Worktree and branch lifecycle policy (tempdoc 952). Sessions own exclusive use of a worktree; the repository's reconciler owns its eventual termination. Ownership markers live in Git (branch config branch.<name>.justsearch-*, worktree lock presence as a liveness hint); a finalization record under tmp/dev-runner/worktrees/ exists only while a resource is being archived and removed. executeOnSchedule stays false in phase 1: the scheduled reconciler only reports and quarantines; explicit release by the owning session may remove. Flip to true only after the A8/A10 metrics have held for two consecutive weeks (952 §3 decision 1).
